why: #192's disk plan requires an update before any operation whose footprint the runtime decision changes. This records that update, before the staging copy runs.

runtime_decision_effect.detail: The adopted runtime reuses torch, already installed and already shipped. The only added dependency is Keras, a pure-Python package.
runtime_decision_effect.measurement: Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File over each site-packages package directory, uncompressed

transient_footprint.contents: keras, torch and their import closure copied out of local site-packages, plus the two .keras checkpoints already in the worktree
transient_footprint.location: session scratchpad, outside the repository and outside the backup media
transient_footprint.durability: transient by design; reproducible from the recorded command, so it is not a recovery dependency

conclusion: Peak additional occupancy stays near 0.6 GB against 45.5 GB free on C:, so #192's recorded budget still holds and needs no revision beyond this addendum. The distribution-size delta from shipping Keras is measured when #204 builds.
not_established_here: The built distribution's size delta. PyInstaller collects a subset of a package, so the site-packages figures above are an upper bound on what the bundle gains, not the bundle delta itself.
